The 2 modules of go-docutils. Each links to its source and to its generated API reference.
Module What it is Reference docutils the engine: a reST parser matching the reference on both of its corpora, the doctree, and HTML and LaTeX writers pkg.go.dev autodoc the other direction: a Go package’s own API documentation rendered AS reST, to feed the engine pkg.go.dev A one-line summary each, and nothing more: what the parser does with a construct, and what it deliberately does not implement, lives in that repository’s README beside the measurement that decided it.
